chunks: From him, from Safwan, from Mansur, from Abu Basir and others, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"Wheat and barley [are sold] head for head, one of them does not increase over the other."
ai.seo_question: What is the rule for selling wheat and barley in equal measure?
ai.summary: This hadith from Sahih al-Tusi specifies that wheat and barley must be exchanged in equal measure (head for head) without excess, establishing them as a single commodity class for the purpose of avoiding riba al-fadl (excess in exchange). This ruling is foundational in Shia jurisprudence for determining which goods are subject to strict equality in spot transactions, distinguishing them from other grains or currencies.
